name: com.mindattic.unity.shared
description: Shared code for every MindAttic Unity game: player profiles, each with one versioned settings.json (format mindattic.settings v1) holding a common block (volumes, mutes, reduce motion, language, display name, colour) and a game-owned block, plus a dependency-free JSON reader/writer. Unity.Shared.Core is engine-free (plain dotnet netstandard2.1); Unity.Shared roots it at Application.persistentDataPath.
